# Rockwall County Housing Market Report

> Monthly residential real estate statistics for Rockwall County, Texas, covering
> the cities of Rockwall, Heath, Fate, McLendon-Chisholm, and Royse City, plus the
> county luxury segment. Published by The Crestedge Group at Keller Williams Rockwall. Source data is NTREIS MLS via 10K
> Research and InfoSparks. Current through July 2026.

## Reports
- [Rockwall County overview](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/): All Rockwall County markets side by side.
- [Rockwall](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/rockwall/): The county seat, with the most established infrastructure and the widest waterfront access on Lake Ray Hubbard.
- [Heath](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/heath/): Larger lots and higher price points, with a quieter character than Rockwall proper.
- [Fate](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/fate/): One of the most active new construction markets in the county, at lower entry prices.
- [McLendon-Chisholm](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/mclendon-chisholm/): Acreage and estate properties on the county’s southern side.
- [Royse City](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/royse-city/): The eastern edge of the county, with the county’s most affordable new construction.
- [Rockwall County Luxury](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/luxury/): Homes priced at $700,000 and above across Rockwall County.

## Data
- [market.json](https://crestedge.github.io/rockwall-market-data/market.json): the full time series behind every page,
  2021-01 through 2026-07, as JSON.
